review.why: Executes a plan with a fresh implementer subagent per task, a task review after each, and one broad review of the whole branch at the end.
review.summary: Dispatches a fresh implementer subagent per task, then a spec and quality review, with one broad review at the end. It runs without pausing between tasks, records conflicts as ledgered rulings and stops only for destructive or security-sensitive actions, outside side effects such as pushing, or a broken plan. Reference files cover batching, fix loops and resuming.
strengths: Fresh context per task limits context pollution
Two-stage review: spec compliance then code quality
Honest cost comparison with inline execution
cautions: Costs a fresh context per task and per review
Needs a harness with subagents and the companion planning skill
Scripts and eight reference files are not read here
